title: Quantifying the failure of symmetry learning in linear diffusion models due to initialization and finite-sample effects
abstract: arXiv:2610.35720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data distributions often possess one or more symmetries: for example, all orientations of any specific dog are included in the distribution of all possible dog pictures. Despite the omnipresence of such symmetries, modern generative modeling approaches may fail to incorporate or learn them, which can lead to lower sample efficiency and poorer generalization. To what extent do diffusion models fail to learn data distribution symmetries, and what sources of symmetry breaking are most responsible? Here, we answer this question in the theoretically tractable setting of linear diffusion models. We show that of three potential sources of symmetry breaking---a non-symmetric initial weight matrix, a noisy learning target, and finite-sample noise---target noise produces the most robust symmetry breaking, since it persists even in the sample-rich regime. Using local laws from random matrix theory, we derive formulas for average symmetry error in f

translated_title: 量化线性扩散模型中由初始化和有限样本效应导致的对称性学习失败
translated_abstract: 数据分布通常具有一个或多个对称性：例如，所有可能的狗的图片分布中包含了任何特定狗的所有朝向。尽管这种对称性无处不在，现代生成建模方法可能无法将其纳入或学习，这可能导致样本效率降低和泛化能力变差。扩散模型在多大程度上无法学习数据分布的对称性？哪些对称性破缺的来源是主要原因？本文在线性扩散模型这一理论可处理的设定中回答了这个问题。我们表明，在三个潜在的对称性破缺来源——非对称的初始权重矩阵、带噪声的学习目标和有限样本噪声——中，目标噪声产生了最稳健的对称性破缺，因为它即使在样本丰富的状态下也会持续存在。利用随机矩阵理论的局部定律，我们推导了平均对称性误差的公式……
tldr: 该论文在线性扩散模型中量化了对称性学习的失败程度，发现在三种对称性破缺来源中，目标噪声的影响最为稳健，即使在样本充足的情况下也会持续破坏对称性学习。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies symmetry learning failure in linear diffusion models and finds that among three sources of symmetry breaking, target noise produces the most robust symmetry breaking, persisting even in the sample-rich regime.
